_comment: Produced by `arch-mind sidecar-scan` from canonical-AST JSON. v0.0.4 / Phase D. Nested working trees (`git worktree` checkouts under .wt/ and .claude/worktrees/) are pruned before indexing: they hold a second copy of the same source, are untracked here, and come and go as parallel agents run, so indexing them makes the score a function of scan-time filesystem state instead of repository content.
